content.text: Almost. Around 6 months is the usual starting point, so Theo's about a month out at 5 months. Until then, milk is all he needs. You can watch for the signs: sitting with little support, good head control, and reaching for your food. When he gets there, start with one iron-rich food (iron-fortified cereal, or well-cooked and mashed meat or lentils) once a day. Confirm the timing with your provider or public health.
